cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: one stronger primary anionic (Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate #2) substantially buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #3, Cocamide DIPA #4 and Glycerin #5 refatting; no second reinforcing anionic or chelating reset route (Disodium EDTA #17 is a minor late chelator). Buildup-removal positioning cannot assign cleansing by itself (3.2).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Olefin sulfonate is a strong anionic and the product claims to remove heavy build-up ('second lather' instruction).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - Glycerin #5, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter #10 (after Parfum), Polyester-37 #11, pearlizer Glycol Distearate #13, Panthenol #14, late cationic polymers Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #15 and Polyquaternium-39 #19. No silicone.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: 'Cream shampoo' with two cationic polymers and a butter could be read as multiple complementary systems (high).

weightPotential.rationale: Low: the lipid (shea butter #10) and both cationic polymers (#15, #19) sit after Parfum; pearlizer #13 and Polyester-37 #11 are light; effective olefin-sulfonate base.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Lighter, mostly late routes; 'late oil can remain low'.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Interacting lighter routes (butter + two polymers + pearlizer) are the plausible path to moderate, recorded as neighbor.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Shea butter is a persistent payload lipid.

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: the lead manufacturer features are buildup removal ('Rich creamy lather removes buildup', 'gently removes heavy build-up from the hair and scalp'; retailer 'Entfernt sanft Produktrückstände'), i.e. a buildup role (7.1); the silicone-free olefin-sulfonate chassis with only late deposition is compatible.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: 'Gentle/mild' wording and moderate conditioning; 'nourish curls' and breakage claims.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: olefin sulfonate + betaine, light-to-moderate late conditioning -> nonspecific/clarifying-compatible. Unblind: buildup-removal is the lead claim -> clarifying; nourishment/breakage claims have no specialist verdict.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'Helps protect against breakage' has no repair cluster (nonspecific); 'nourish curls' is texture/outcome wording (§8, F1).

usageRole.rationale: Regular: alternating requires strong cleansing; no D1 lexicon term (so not occasional_reset); no explicit daily wording.
usageRole.counterSignal: Buildup intent would make it alternating if cleansing were strong.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C moderate: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T2: 'strukturiertes Haar'/curls/coils ignored. T4: W neighbor moderate would make fine acceptable -> review_thickness_boundary (fine); C neighbor high would raise coarse (no flag).
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY: no E2 scalp claim (buildup removal from scalp is not an oily-scalp claim).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong would give clarifying (alternating + clarifying focus), not the bucket's expected regular -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false: 'removes buildup' is not a D1 lexicon term and directions do not limit frequency.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Formula identity: the manufacturer page warns its ingredient list may differ from packaging by time/region; the packet's canonical INCI was used as frozen, with confidences capped at moderate where formula-dependent. §2 gives no rule for a generic 'may vary' disclaimer without a concrete conflicting list.
Manufacturer claims are English on a page used for the German product; E1 'exact manufacturer DE page' status is unclear (not material: no scalp target).

Clarifying focus with only moderate cleansing: 7.1 accepts a 'buildup role with compatible architecture' but does not define compatible; the clarifying focus then cannot reach alternating/clarifying intensity, so focus and intensity diverge.
C1 is written for ether sulfates; olefin sulfonate + betaine without reset architecture resolved via the moderate anchor.
